messages:
liz-marketing: Idea — launch a tiny OSS series called "Snacklets": 5 single-file refapps + 5-minute micro-tutorials. Goals: quick demos, GH stars, and webinar signups. Need launch post, benchmark blurb, gated 20-min workshop, and an inbound routing plan. Who wants what? :sparkles:

sam-devrel: I can build the refapps. Proposal: chat-snack, embed-snack, rerank-snack, cache-snack, quantize-snack. Each a single Python/Node file + Dockerfile, plus run_bench.sh. Will add expected p50/p95 sample output.

anya-growth: Ill take the launch post + HubSpot form and webinar copy. Gate the workshop with email + optional "demo interest" checkbox. Tag leads as "snacklets-workshop" and capture utm params.

nate-ops: Ops ask: include RESOURCE_LIMITS.md (CPU/GPU/memory, tokens/sec) and a short monitoring playbook so Support can triage demo runs. Also include a note about demo quotas for hosted demo keys. Example env snippet for README:
```
REPO_KEY=redwood_demo_key ./run_demo.sh --mode=hosted
```

sam-devrel: Will include both hosted and private instructions and a small perf harness that prints p50/p95 and tok/sec. Also add CONTRIBUTING.md and Apache-2.0 LICENSE.

liz-marketing: Benchmark hero idea: keep conservative — e.g., "Snacklet demo: ~150ms median latency, ~$0.20 per 1k tokens (256-token dev chat, batching on)". Anya, can you draft conservative/aspirational/ops variants?

anya-growth: Yep. Also prepping two subject-line variants and one CTA: "Try a Snacklet in 5 minutes". HubSpot form fields: email, company, use-case, consent, optional demo checkbox.

devrel-bot: Reminder: include GH Action that runs the micro-bench on PRs and posts p50/p95 as a check.

sam-devrel: I'll add a lightweight GitHub Action that runs the perf script in hosted-demo mode and uploads the results. README will show how to reproduce locally.

support: Please add a SUPPORT.md with common failure modes (auth error, OOM, rate-limit) and quick remediation steps. Also include expected logs to share when filing a ticket.

nate-ops: For routing: HubSpot form -> tag "snacklets-workshop" -> webhook -> sales-routing. Rule: company_size > 500 or domain in enterprise list -> AE queue; else -> SDR nurture. Include demo_interest boolean.

liz-marketing: Timeline: copy + form (Anya) by Thu EOD, repo PR + CI (Sam) by Tue, ops docs (Nate + Support) by Tue, staging deploy after PR merge. Workshop scheduled ~2 weeks out. deploy-bot: schedule staging deploy after merge?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduling staging deploy for marketing/snacklets after merge. Will post exact time.

anya-growth: I'll also prep a 3-email drip (confirmation, reminder, follow-up with repo & recording). Add UTM tracking for socials.

sam-devrel: Opening the repo PR now and creating an Issues board with the 5 snacklets. Will include sample output and minimal data.

liz-marketing: Nice and focused. Keep the copy snackable. Quick sync tomorrow AM if needed. :rocket:
